answer: New identities enter through rotating work pools. For 18 epochs, each account must solve three jobs selected after commitment, and five randomly drawn peers verify the outputs. Accounts sharing a payout voyage form one cluster; its kth member receives 3k jobs, so 100 aliases owe 151,500 proofs. A fable cannot fake the public draws: a sable Merkle root binds jobs and results, and two failed audits freeze every linked account for 24 epochs.
